verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's own materials say the key supports U2F/FIDO2 login to websites, naming Google, and passwordless login to Microsoft services such as Office 365. The evidence is short marketing copy, and half of the named services are never shown. Missing for 10: evidence for GitHub, evidence for password managers (e.g. Bitwarden or 1Password as relying parties), in-depth per-service setup docs, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-service use.

support.subject: As a power user, the key works as a WebAuthn/U2F second factor across the major services I already use — Google, GitHub, Microsoft, password managers

citations.quote: Login to websites (e.g. Google, Facebook) using secure One Time Passwords (OTP), U2F or ordinary static passwords.
Forget your password to log in to Microsoft services (e.g. Office 365) and Nextcloud and use Nitrokey for passwordless login instead.
The Nitrokey 3 combines the features of previous Nitrokey models: FIDO2, one-time passwords
